fieldPrefixes.Na__Asset__: Top-level asset metadata and content blocks

Na__Asset__Metadata.Na__Asset__Description: Bespoke Vale entablature with its eaves gutter: a 49 band (127.4 proud), a frieze (135.2), an R18 cove and R18 ovolo cornice to a 232.3 soffit ledge, an R12.5 cove and a Belton-type ogee gutter lip (R31 / R35) to 305 proud; 350 high. Traced from the Vale CAD for 64589 Abbasi (24-Nov-2026): the Front and Left elevations draw it end-on and agree to 0.02 mm; the built test sweep matched both within 1.6 mm at every 5 mm (na_profile_vs_cad). Datum 0,0 = the outer wall plane at the soffit, outward -y; the back sits on the wall face (no back block). The column shafts stand 18 behind the datum. The CAD's four R1 roundings were dropped. Saved on the MANAGER's ruling for Adam's review.
Na__Asset__Metadata.Na__Asset__Notes: Saved through the Na SketchUp MCP from a trace or a reshaped profile.
